calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 28% to INR1,439 cr with collections up 40%, but net debt INR2,836 cr and debt-cut target of INR700 cr is being softened by new land buys; FY27 presales guidance of INR11,200 cr held.

calls.name: V-Guard Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: more than 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: V-Guard Q1 FY27 revenue +23.5% (≈14% price, ≈9% volume) with 10.5% EBITDA margin, but wires volumes near zero as customers defer after steep price hikes and new entrants arrive.

calls.name: Health X Platform Ltd
calls.gLine: RetailerShakti EBITDA: positive EBITDA in Q3 FY27 (Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Health X grew revenue 58% YoY to INR440 crores with EBITDA still negative at -3.4% margin and gross margin 7.8%; management refuses EBITDA focus and gives no segment P&L, with no capacity-discipline or pricing evidence.

calls.name: Suyog Telematics Ltd
calls.gLine: Total tenancies FY27 exit: 10,000+ tenancies (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR710m (+6.1% y/y on restated basis) with EBITDA margin cut to 59.3% after electricity moved into revenue; growth hinges on Vodafone Idea tenancy loading (150 done, ~700 more, 3,000 FY27 target) with BSNL billing stalled.

calls.name: Wonderla Holidays Ltd
calls.gLine: Chennai footfall to 1 million: Not in one year; a couple of years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR243 crore with EBITDA margin 48%, driven by Chennai ramp (INR45 crore) and mature parks ARPU +8%; supply additions ongoing but no new capacity capex guidance beyond ~10% of revenue.

calls.name: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 21-22% in next 2 years; 24-25% long term (2 years / 4-5 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR6,951m on 11% volume growth, ARPP only +2%; adjusted EBITDA margin 19.4% (+120bp) with management targeting 21-22% in two years and 25% in four to five.

calls.name: Bigbloc Construction Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: improve further over next two to three quarters from ~8% (2-3 quarters)
calls.thesis: Bigbloc Q1 FY27 utilisation ~69% on 1.3 mn cbm capacity with EBITDA margin ~8% (INR 6 cr on INR 79 cr); pricing hikes promised but MP plant expansion pushed to FY28 start, keeping capacity-add risk alive.

calls.name: HPL Electric & Power Ltd
calls.gLine: C&I revenue growth: high double digit growth over next 12-18 months (12-18 months)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 35% to ₹515 cr with EBITDA margin down to 12.26% on metals and plastics inflation; management sees margin recovery only after a lag, with no capacity expansion signalled for metering.

calls.name: Godrej Agrovet Ltd
calls.gLine: Astec revenue growth FY27: at least more than 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Crop Care revenue fell 16.2% on a dry June and cotton herbicide weakness, while Oil Palm and Animal Nutrition grew; management still targets double-digit consolidated PBT growth, though it defers the number to end-September.

calls.name: BMW Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Pipes and tubes utilisation about 40.1% annualised (up from ~34% in FY26) on 0.5 Mt added capacity, rolling mill ~83.5%; EBITDA margin fell to 20.3% on fuel costs while gross margin rose to 67.9%.
calls.top: Eastern region capacity additions flagged by analyst

calls.name: Artemis Medicare Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Gurgaon EBITDA margin: 20-21% in FY27; 23-24% over 2-3 years (FY27 to 2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 287.32 cr (+12.7%) and EBITDA margin 21.5%; Gurugram occupancy 65.7% with ~200-bed Tower IV and INR 800 cr three-year capex plan adds supply, with a INR 700 cr equity enabling resolution.

calls.name: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 15-16% by FY30 (FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR548.7 crore and EBITDA margin 13.1%, with management targeting 14% by Q4 despite a sharper input-cost hit guided for Q2; no capacity cut, and capex of about INR3,400-3,500 crore is being added.

calls.name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd
calls.gLine: BT out rate: around 5% to 6% (near term)
calls.thesis: Housing finance book growing 25.7% YoY with stable asset quality (30+ DPD 3.2%) and spread guided at 5–5.25%; no capacity or pricing-supply signals, growth driven by home loans and ticket size.

calls.name: Alivus Life Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 10% to 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 6.4% to INR640 crores with GPL down 52.6%, offset by non-GPL growth of 26.5%; capacity deliberately paced with Solapur delayed to early Q3 and FY27 revenue guided at 10-12%.
calls.top: GPL inventory rationalisation drives Q1 dip

calls.name: Metro Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: E-commerce growth: 20% to 30% healthy
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone sales +9% with SOR 3P drag and April–May softness, June recovered to mid-teens; gross margin near 60%, EBITDA ~30%, PAT guidance held at 13–15% with no supply-side signals.
calls.top: June growth mid-teens after soft Apr–May

calls.name: Modis Navnirman Ltd
calls.gLine: Redevelopment projects to add: two to three projects in this year
calls.thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27.9% YoY to INR58.26 cr, but EBITDA margin fell from ~22.3% to ~19.8% on war-driven material and labour cost hits; no capacity or capital-cycle signals.

calls.name: IKIO Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41% YoY to Rs169cr and EBITDA margin 13%, but management concedes gross margin fell to ~41% on metals and semiconductor cost/lead-time shocks, and capacity is ahead of demand with only Rs20-25cr capex left.

calls.name: Happy Forgings Ltd
calls.gLine: Industrial share of revenue (medium term): Industrials to double in 3-4 years; PV 12-15%; industrials+PV 45-50% of revenue (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs449cr (+27%) and EBITDA margin 31.3%, but forging utilisation only 59% with 4,000t press added; price hikes of ~4.5-5% on domestic book start from Q2.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross store additions FY27: more than 300 stores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 11% to Rs 2,046 cr and EBITDA margin up 50 bps to 16%, but gross margin fell ~150 bps on channel mix and provisioning; supply-side signals are absent and the company is guiding 300+ gross store adds.

calls.name: Sambhv Steel Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth over FY26: 10-15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR732 crore and EBITDA INR100 crore with utilisation near limits, Kesda 3.6 lakh t stainless capacity due Q4 FY27 and FY27 EBITDA/ton guided 7,500-8,500 versus Q1 above 10,000.
calls.top: Stainless capacity 1.16 → 4.76 lakh t by Q4 FY27

calls.name: Travel Food Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Travel F&B operator grew system-wide sales 18% and PAT 35.6% on flat traffic, but LFL slowed to 0.8% (7% ex-disrupted markets) and EBITDA margin fell to 35.8% on pre-opening costs for 87 new outlets.

calls.name: Regaal Resources Ltd
calls.gLine: Crushing volume FY27: above 400,000 tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 operating income fell 18% to Rs 202 crore on exit from low-margin trading, while value-added margin rose to 39.8% and utilisation was 71.4% on a doubled 1,650 TPD crushing plant; net debt Rs 735 crore with inventory-heavy working capital.

calls.name: Physicswallah Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,054 crore (+24% YoY) with pre-Ind AS EBITDA -INR44 crore; management reiterates FY27 30% revenue and 100% EBITDA growth but NEET shift cut Q1 offline growth to 14%.
calls.top: NEET shift cut offline growth to 14%

calls.name: Aequs Ltd
calls.thesis: Aerospace order book crossed USD1,004m (+13% QoQ) and revenue +40% YoY, but consumer utilisation fell to ~22% and operational EBITDA of INR148m still leans on a Q4 FY27 consumer breakeven that needs utilisation to rise to 40-50%.

calls.name: Corona Remedies Ltd
calls.thesis: Corona Remedies Q1 FY27 revenue +21.9% YoY to INR422 crore, EBITDA margin 22% (+190bps); growth is mostly volume-led and FY27 guidance of 15% organic plus 20% PAT was held, with raw-material risk flagged.

calls.name: MV Electrosystems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Post-IPO rail propulsion ramp from ~10 units in September to ~40/month by January on a 564-unit order book (INR989 crore); no deliveries in the prior two months, so the thesis rests on unproven execution.

calls.name: Behari Lal Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: High-value product share of revenue: ~70% in near future (near future)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin expansion came from mix (high-value 60.4% of revenue, EBITDA/ton ~13,500), but melt capacity is unchanged until Unit 3 next year, with FY27 capex of INR80 crore (only INR5 crore spent in Q1).

calls.name: Sagar Cements Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY28: double-digit (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up ~13% but EBITDA/tonne fell to ₹451 on West Asia energy costs; management still reiterates ₹500–550/t for FY27 and 7 Mt volumes, with no new capex through FY28.

calls.name: Viyash Scientific Ltd
calls.gLine: Animal Health API growth: 20%+ (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 946 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA margin 21.6%, but API flat QoQ on customer wait-and-see; management guides Animal API +20%, company 13-15% growth this year.
calls.top: API customers delayed orders in June

calls.name: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 launch pipeline: around INR3,000 crores (Wadala boutique office ~INR3,600 crores single phase)
calls.thesis: Mumbai luxury/mid-market developer with Q1 revenue up 23% to INR320 crores and debt down to INR680 crores (D/E 0.47x), but Q1 sales of only INR146 crores and launches slipping, so supply-side evidence is thin.

calls.name: Baroda Extrusion Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue/profit growth FY27-28: 35% to 40% minimum rise
calls.thesis: Small copper extruder (~Rs 48 cr quarterly revenue, EBITDA margin ~7.7%) with a planned Rs 20-25 cr extrusion press expansion; management talk is heavy on vision and light on numbers, with volume and capacity figures that contradict each other.

calls.name: Aarti Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA of Rs 385 cr (+79% YoY) was flattered by inventory and FX gains (guided Rs 50-60 cr), volumes fell 12% QoQ, and management declined to hold the run rate; Zone IV ramp is delayed.

calls.name: Sanghvi Movers Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 revenue +39% YoY to Rs 380 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 35% from 40% QoQ; core crane margin 47% vs 53%, with receivables ageing (DSO 116 days) and FY27 EBITDA guidance held at Rs 525-575 cr.

calls.name: Eveready Industries India Ltd
calls.gLine: Alkaline market share: 25% to 30% exit share in 2 years (2 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR407.7 cr (+9% YoY), EBITDA margin 15.1% on price actions, but alkaline Jammu plant just commissioned and management flags zinc inflation and possible further price/margin corrections.

calls.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
calls.gLine: Ethanol capacity utilisation: 100-110% of existing capacity by FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA Rs91cr at 14.2% margin on strong ethanol realisations, but management guides FY27 EBITDA margin 10-11% and says Q2 is seasonally weak; capacity debottleneck to 100-110% by FY28 with no major capex until FY28.

calls.name: Suprajit Engineering Ltd
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +24% to INR1,070 cr and EBITDA +57%, but standalone EBITDA flat at INR60 cr as India wage inflation squeezed ICM margin from ~15% to 13%; management calls it timing and guides held.

calls.name: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd
calls.thesis: Capex largely done (~Rs 350 cr FY27 guide), utilisation ramp to 75-80% before next capex; net debt cut to Rs 1,900 cr with Rs 500 cr reduction targeted this year, but margin gains partly offset by unpassed energy and shipping costs.

calls.name: PG Electroplast Ltd
calls.gLine: H2/FY27 RAC volume growth: 15-20% for 6 months; ~20%+ full year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,034 cr (+35%) but operating margin 7.3% under commodity/rupee pressure; management targets ~8% FY27 margin and a compressor line plus 1.2 mn refrigerator plant adds capacity into a tightening import-restricted market.

calls.name: PDS Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 15% to ₹3,444 cr and EBITDA margin up to 2.8% (from 1.7%), with order book up 23% to ₹6,095 cr, but guidance stays qualitative and the order-book growth is not yet capacity-led.

calls.name: Minda Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR 400-odd crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,846 cr (+33% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.5%, but ~INR 106 cr exceptional gain inflates PAT; no capacity-discipline signal, FY27 capex ~INR 400 cr spread across verticals.

calls.name: Sunrakshakk Industries India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR900-1,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 120.6% YoY to INR276.33 cr but consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 8.18% from 10.19% QoQ on raw-material and crude-linked cost pressure; management guides ~6% FY27 PAT margin and says utilisation is only 50-55%.

calls.name: SIS Ltd
calls.gLine: Labour code EBITDA/PAT impact: accretive over next 3-4 quarters
calls.thesis: SIS Q1 FY27 revenue INR 4,604 cr (+29.7% YoY) with consolidated EBITDA margin 4.5%; flat QoQ, and labour-code wage pass-through is the main tailwind, but no supply or capacity signal.

calls.name: Chalet Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Planned capex FY27-FY29: approx INR30 billion, largely internal accruals (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: Hotel-led growth with RevPAR +6.5% on ADR +8.5%, but resort occupancy only ~51% and MMR (Powai, Vashi) dragged by construction; supply view is benign, capex ~INR30bn FY27-29 funded internally.

calls.name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Specialty share of revenue: 45% from 40% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% to INR 450 cr on volume (patients +10%, tests +11%) with no price hike; EBITDA margin 25.2% (+210 bps), but supply-side discipline is mostly absent as 500+ net centres are being added.

calls.name: Stove Kraft Ltd
calls.gLine: Induction cooktop share of revenue: at least 20% and a little above
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41.3% to INR480.6 cr and EBITDA margin 11.2% (+71bp), but growth is driven by a demand spike in induction cooktops; management is guiding to a 2x induction year and gross margin up at least 1% YoY with no capacity-discipline evidence.

calls.name: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 376.6 cr (+85% YoY) with EBITDA margin ~9.3% flat QoQ; compressor utilisation only ~50% and AC capacity 1.0→1.8m sets with 50-60% FY28 utilisation planned, so capacity additions outrun demand visibility.

calls.name: Uniparts India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: a couple of percentage points above FY26 growth of 21% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR347 crore (+27% YoY), EBITDA INR90 crore (~26% margin); no capacity additions discussed beyond maintenance-type capex of INR12 crore, growth driven by construction and new wins, with FY27 growth guided a few points above FY26's 21%.

calls.name: Khazanchi Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year growth: around 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 45% to INR586 crore with EBITDA margin 6.82%, but volume growth only ~15% and no supply-side disclosure (capacity, capex quantum, grams sold withheld); management guides 25-30% growth and 5,000 crore by 2030.

calls.name: Honasa Consumer Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin expansion FY27: 150-200 bps
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth 32% with 30.5% volume growth, EBITDA near INR110 cr; inventory discipline (distributor stock under 30 days) and calibrated price hikes, but margin lift partly one-time and seasonal.

calls.name: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 PAT ₹143 cr (+23% YoY) and ROE 17.5% held, but Stage 3 rose to 1.5% and management guides only a Q3 turn; disbursement cut to ₹641 cr by a one-time recognition change.

calls.name: INOX India Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow: slightly above INR450-500 cr per quarter (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record INR532 cr order inflow and INR1,686 cr order book, but Q1 revenue of INR382 cr missed the INR410-415 cr target and EBITDA grew only 1.4%; mgmt reiterates 18-20% FY27 growth.

calls.name: Suraj Estate Developers Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 10-15% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Mumbai developer with Q1 FY27 sales value up 74% to INR141 crores but collections down to INR86 crores from INR115 crores and net debt rising to INR614 crores; no supply discipline signal, just launch and leverage ramp.

calls.name: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Effective tax rate FY27: 22.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Entero's Q1 FY27 shows EBITDA margin at 5.0% (+143bp YoY) and organic growth of 19.6% like-for-like, but it is a pharma distributor with no capacity-cycle signals; supply-side metrics are absent and the call leans on guidance reiteration.

calls.name: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 revenue: INR2,700 crores (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 revenue up 20.7% to INR460 crores with EBITDA margin flat at 8.6%; capacity additions (Gujarat, heavy structure, Andhra Phase 2) ramp into FY27-28 while order book rose to INR1,864 crores and FY27 revenue guidance held at INR2,150-2,200 crores.
calls.top: Capex ~INR250 cr over 2 years, QIP upsized

calls.name: Sai Life Sciences Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 12% to INR553 crore with CRO +26% and CDMO only +6%; management keeps 15-20% mid-term growth and INR1,100-1,300 crore capex, with H2 weighted to new Bidar capacity.

calls.name: Laxmi Dental Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR74.7cr (+13.9%) and EBITDA margin 19.2%, but growth is mix-led from scanners; no capacity expansion beyond machinery and a Palghar land LOI, with lab utilisation already at 90-95%.

calls.name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd
calls.gLine: Mehru EBITDA margin: around 18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margins strong (gross 47.2%, EBITDA 25.2% reported, 28.3% ex-Ind AS 29) but capacity is ramping slowly: Sangli trials only this month, approvals ~six months, FY27 guidance held at 20% growth with no raise.

calls.name: GK Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Interest expense: stay near INR 5 cr per quarter (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 71% to INR 505 cr and 24,118 pump installs (2x), but growth rests on PM-KUSUM 2.0 timing (expected Q3) that management could not firmly pin down; realisations per pump falling.

calls.name: Jain Resource Recycling Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper value-added EBITDA uplift: +2% to copper margin / ~Rs 25 per tonne once stabilised (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 76% to Rs 2,725 cr but EBITDA margin ~4% vs 5.8% a year ago; management offers no numeric guidance, with copper EBITDA/tonne ~Rs 31,000 vs Rs 36,000 FY26 average.
calls.top: No volume or EBITDA numeric guidance

calls.name: Trualt Bioenergy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 ethanol sales volume: ~44 crore litres (order book)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 ethanol volumes ~8.3-8.5 crore litres on ~60% utilisation with a 44 crore litre FY27 order book, but margins rest on cheap grain inventory that management says will fade at INR25.50/kg maize.
calls.top: Maize at INR25.50 squeezes margin to INR6-7/litre

calls.name: Sai Parenterals Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 182 cr (incl. Noumed) with gross margin 41.8% and EBITDA 14.9%; IPO capex re-routed into a 60% stake in a project under construction, with FY27 guidance of Rs 750 cr and 17% EBITDA held.
calls.top: IPO capex redeployed into Saicriti 60% stake

calls.name: One Point One Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue: Roughly double FY27 revenue (qualitative, from analyst Q&A) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue INR 158.3 cr (+129% YoY) mostly from first full quarter of Netcom acquisition; base standalone revenue +11.6% YoY with 30.4% margin, no capacity or pricing data disclosed.

calls.name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd
calls.gLine: Further price hikes: 2% to 3% in current month (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~24% to INR4,215 cr but consolidated margin fell to 9.6% as raw-material and strategic spend hit; price hikes of ~3% in June plus 2-3% planned lag pass-through, and capex of INR1,700 cr is largely new energy.

calls.name: Sundrop Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin (ESOP-adjusted): ~7% today, 12% by FY30 target (3 years)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +15% YoY with EBITDA steady near 7% (ESOP-adjusted ~5.7%); growth is demand and investment-led, with no capacity or supply-discipline signal, and a 12% FY30 margin target that is aspirational.

calls.name: Max Financial Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Axis Max Life VNB margin rose to 23.2% (from 20.3%) and VNB grew 33%, driven by protection mix and yield curve, while solvency sits at 198% after Axis's ₹381 crore infusion.

calls.name: Century Enka Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: over Rs 100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 15.5% flattered by Rs 46.24 cr one-time inventory gain; management reiterates 7-10% normalised margin, capacity flat until FY28, utilisation 85-90%.
calls.top: Inventory gain Rs 46.24 cr flatters quarter

calls.name: Castrol India Ltd
calls.thesis: Castrol India Q2 CY26 revenue INR1,871 crore (+25% YoY) and EBITDA margin ~26%, helped by one-off benefit from cheaper inventory; management says costs hit P&L more in Q3 and pricing is the lever, with a 21-24% EBITDA band.
calls.top: Old low-cost inventory flattered Q2 margin

calls.name: Triton Valves Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ~15 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 group sales up ~38% YoY to ~186.5 cr with tax-credit-boosted PAT, but EBITDA margin compressed on copper pass-through and climate control is weak; no capacity discipline, capex raised to ~15 cr.

calls.name: PCBL Chemical Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ~INR300 crore +/- INR50 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 carbon black EBITDA/t ~INR22,900 lifted by low-cost inventory (~INR70 cr, INR40-50 cr to reverse); management held FY27 EBITDA/t guidance at INR16,500-17,000 and Q2 volumes soft on timing.

calls.name: Carborundum Universal Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated Ceramics sales growth: 23% to 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone sales up 21.2% YoY to INR 846 cr on volume, with EMD exports rising, but Abrasive margins are squeezed by oil-linked and fuel cost push and Foskor and Awuko exits remain unresolved.

calls.name: Viceroy Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Courtyard occupancy: 80% to 85% over next 2 FYs (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Hotel-owner Viceroy Q1 FY27 revenue up 77% to INR44.9 cr and EBITDA margin 26.3%, but PAT just INR1.4 cr as finance cost quadrupled; supply is expanding (Phase 2 Marriott rooms offline, Greenfield 200-key) with no capacity discipline.

calls.name: NRB Bearings Ltd
calls.gLine: FY31 revenue vision: INR3,000 crores aspirational; INR2,700 crores on trailing growth
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 19.2% to INR370 crores and PAT up 15% to INR38 crores; capex of INR270 crores (INR60 crores spent) with a INR130 crore capacity from INR110 crore Unitec JV, but no utilisation or pricing data.
calls.top: Capex INR270 crores; INR60 crores spent

calls.name: Oriental Rail Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated FY27 turnover: around INR700 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16.7% to INR137.6 cr and EBITDA margin 15.2%, but wagon utilisation was ~50% in FY26 and management guided ~500 wagons in Q2 vs 300-odd in Q1, with 3,800-wagon order book and no operating cash flow in FY25-26.

calls.name: Karnataka Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Margin-led beat: NIM 3.20% (vs 3.07% Q4) and CD ratio 78.45% (vs 71.93% a year ago) show balance sheet turning, but management's answers on SMA-2 build-up (INR750 crore) and mid-corporate growth were evasive.

calls.name: Cantabil Retail India Ltd
calls.gLine: Store openings Q2: 28-30 stores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +13% to INR178.8 cr with SSG 4.04% and 667 stores; no supply discipline signal as store adds accelerate to 30 in Q2, and management reiterates INR1,000 cr FY27 target that needs ~18-19% growth.
calls.top: Q2 volume growth muted, H2 stronger

calls.name: JTL Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Mangaon capacity addition: ~1 million tons by end H1 FY27
calls.thesis: Record Q1 volume of 118,513 t (+17.8% YoY) and company utilisation of 55% rising to ~65% by year-end, but EBITDA/t of ~INR4,954 includes a ~INR200 Defence boost; capacity goes to 2 Mt by FY28-29.

calls.name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: around 15%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR924 cr (+53% YoY) on 889 MWp executed; INR5,300 cr unexecuted order book includes ~INR2,400 cr solar EPC and ~INR200 cr BESS, with no formal guidance given and consolidated margin diluted by T&D acquisition.

calls.name: Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd
calls.gLine: Launch booking value FY27: INR3,000-3,500 crore across 6 launches
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 147% to INR432 crore and revenue jumped on one OC, but the read is a real-estate developer with no capacity or utilisation data; guidance held, OCF of INR81 crore vs full-year INR400-500 crore target.

calls.name: Gujarat Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Morbi minimum volume: 1.8-2 mmscmd floor (next quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gas-trading EBT of INR726 crores on Brent-linked contracts and Morbi volume surge; management holds INR1,100 crore FY27 trading guidance, which looks conservative against the quarter.

calls.name: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt reduction: Rs 25 crore per quarter from Q3 (FY27 onward)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14% to Rs 662 crore and EBITDA up 21%, but about Rs 15 crore of Flavour sales was pre-emptive stocking, and net debt rose Rs 65 crore to Rs 852 crore on inventory and capex.
calls.top: Net debt up Rs 65 cr to Rs 852 cr

calls.name: Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens rather than early teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 19.1% to Rs 798 crore with EBITDA margin 31.0%, driven by CGHS price pass-through (2-3%) and mix; no supply-side capacity signal as management says capacity is never a constraint.
calls.top: Margin guide tilts to mid-teens growth

calls.name: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd
calls.thesis: AdTech platform reports Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 728m (+56.9% YoY) and PAT margin 16.1%, but no supply-side data; growth is company-driven with limited capacity or pricing disclosure beyond revenue per outcome of Rs 49.94.

calls.name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: A&P as % of sales FY27: similar to last year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +11.8% to Rs 2,235 cr and EBITDA margin +20 bps to 10%, but management admits ~Rs 200 cr primary sales lost to supply disruption; pricing covered ~80% of inflation and Q2 start is strong.

calls.name: Share India Securities Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue/profit growth: around 20% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT Rs 124.41 cr (+48% YoY) led by MTF book (~Rs 470 cr) and subsidiaries, but prop still ~52% of profit and management guides ~20% growth with no capacity or supply-side metrics.
calls.top: PMS AUM Rs 150 cr in first quarter

calls.name: MAS Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Direct distribution share: 70% to 72% in 1-1.5 years (1-1.5 years)
calls.thesis: MAS Financial Q1 FY27 shows steady 21% AUM growth and a 25% PAT rise, but credit cost has drifted up to about 1.6% and management is guiding to a wide 1.25–1.75% range rather than a firm number.
calls.top: Eligible demand dipped on energy-linked tightening

calls.name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% against 20-30% expected, PAT down to INR95 crore from INR111 crore as depreciation and interest hit before IPP revenue ramps; margins under geopolitical cost pressure at KP Energy.
calls.top: PAT margin FY27 guide to be lower

calls.name: Aartech Solonics Ltd
calls.gLine: Next quarters revenue and margins: Expected to be very healthy
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue rose about 1.5x year on year to Rs 728 lakhs and PBT rose to Rs 119 lakhs from Rs 73 lakhs, but the call gave no capacity, utilisation or pricing data and pipeline conversion remained vague.

calls.name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: ARPOB growth: 4-5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,196 crore (+36% YoY) with IP volumes +26.6%, but Kondapur ramp, new-unit losses and a 50% occupancy base keep supply absorption the key test; ARPOB guided to 4-5% growth.

calls.name: Harsha Engineers International Ltd
calls.gLine: Advantek revenue: Rs 140 cr plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated engineering supply Rs 421 cr (+21% YoY) with EBITDA Rs 69.8 cr, down from Rs 77 cr QoQ on a raw-material pass-through lag; capacity expansion at Bhayla and China continues.
calls.top: Raw material up ~8% YoY, pass-through lagged

calls.name: Global Health Ltd
calls.gLine: Noida EBITDA breakeven: earlier than previous expectations
calls.thesis: Medanta Q1 FY27 shows volume-led growth (IP +28%, ARPOB +5%) and Noida EBITDA loss cut to INR49m from INR236m, but no capex cut, no numeric guidance and a 3,350-bed pipeline keeps supply expanding.

calls.name: Landmark Cars Ltd
calls.gLine: Normalised EBITDA margin on new car sales: 1.5% (analyst framing, not confirmed by management) (Q2-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Auto retailer with a strong Q1 (revenue up 22%+, PAT nearly doubled) but no capacity discipline or numeric guidance; growth is volume-led, with a gross-margin definition shift and EV aftersales claims that management did not quantify.

calls.name: Blue Jet Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Iodinated intermediate commercial batches: positive trend by end Q2 or beginning Q3
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR293 cr (+25% QoQ) on PI/API restart, but contrast media fell ~40% QoQ on ~INR30 cr goods-in-transit; plant utilisation steady at 70-odd percent with capex ~INR250 cr in FY27.
calls.top: Goods in transit up ~INR30 cr QoQ

calls.name: RBZ Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Store break-even: capex break-even in a year or less
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR121 crore (+60% YoY) and EBITDA margin 14.9%, but factory runs at ~50% utilisation and management is expanding stores (INR10 crore Surat capex) and shifting to gold metal loans, with EBITDA margin pressure and no segment profit disclosure.
calls.top: Gold metal loan shift to hedge inventory

calls.name: EPACK Durable Ltd
calls.gLine: AC industry growth FY27: ~20%, EPACK to outgrow
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~34% to INR886 cr with RAC volume up ~30%, but EBITDA margin fell to 6.21% (6.4% underlying ex-PLI) on forex loss and wage costs; utilisation guided to 55-60% and capex only INR60-70 cr more.

calls.name: JNK India Ltd
calls.gLine: Chemdist revenue share FY27: 10% to 15% of JNK India revenue
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 80.6% to INR 186 cr with EBITDA margin 11.8% after Chemdist JV loss; order book INR 1,801 cr, but Q1 is seasonally 10-15% of FY revenue and the Chemdist-driven margin dip plus a cancelled export order temper the read.

calls.name: Indegene Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 19% to 20% in H2 FY27; back by Q4 FY27 (Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Indegene Q1 FY27 revenue up 26.5% YoY in USD to $112.5m with EBITDA 16.9%; management reiterates 19–20% margin recovery by Q4 FY27, but this is a services firm with no capacity data and it is a services/pharma commercial business, so the capital-cycle read is thin.
calls.top: Margin recovery to 19–20% by Q4 FY27

calls.name: Raymond Lifestyle Ltd
calls.gLine: Garmenting EBITDA margin: no firm guidance; double-digit is an endeavour
calls.thesis: Garmenting grew 50% to INR296 crore with EBITDA margin 7.3% and plants full till December, but branded apparel grew only 4% and EBO network shrank 34 net stores; no capacity added, store cuts ongoing.

calls.name: GNG Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30% (raised from 25%)
calls.thesis: Refurbished-PC reseller posts 32% revenue growth and 24.65% gross margin on inventory built ahead of price rises; supply-side evidence is thin and margin gains rest on stockpiling and unverified trust-premium claims.

calls.name: Amanta Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: approx INR370 crores excl. SVP (FY27)
calls.thesis: SteriPort Line 3 commissioning slipped one quarter to late August on civil delays, pushing ~INR70 crores of contribution into FY27 and leaving the INR370 crore base case intact; margin guidance of 25-26% for FY28 rests on capacity still to be built.
calls.top: Price hike INR1.50 vs polymer cost INR2.25

calls.name: Molbio Diagnostics Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: ~25% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Molbio's Truenat point-of-care platform is capacity-rich (kits at 58%, devices at 42% utilisation) with guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 24–25% EBITDA; no prior guidance was supplied to check against.

calls.name: Hy-Tech Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: ~20% minimum YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR430m but EBITDA margin fell to 19.6% from 21.5%; management attributes it to price pass-through lagging into Q2 and guides ~20% growth and 24-25% margin, with capacity at 60-70% utilisation.
calls.top: Input cost pass-through deferred to Q2

calls.name: TIL Ltd
calls.gLine: Turnover growth: Significant jump this year; tripling in 5-7 years (FY27 and 5-7 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR117.1 cr (+86%) with partial Tulip consolidation; standalone EBITDA margin 4.3% and management sees no margin fix for six to eight quarters, with no capex beyond bridging.
calls.top: Debtor days stressed after March billing

calls.name: Ugro Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: Closing AUM FY27: flat
calls.thesis: Opex cut to ~INR 119 cr/qtr (from 217) and ~INR 2,551 cr disbursements, but on-book interest income fell 13% QoQ and co-lending/DA income halved to INR 75 cr; capital-cycle reset is real yet earnings quality still in transition.

calls.name: Vishnu Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Strontium utilisation: 65% to 75% by year-end (FY27 end)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 24.9% to INR433.4 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 15.1% from 16.1%; South Africa chrome mine still not producing, gross margin 44-45% vs 50% target by year-end.
calls.top: Freight cost ~20% of revenue in Q2

calls.name: Hindustan Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex projects: INR340 crores new projects plus INR150 crores carry forward (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record PAT of INR42.8 crores (+33% YoY) with FY27 PAT guidance of INR200-220 crores reaffirmed; footwear hit ~INR6 crores and shoe utilisation was poor in Q1, though new capex of INR340 crores is announced.
calls.top: Footwear cost pass-through lag ~INR6 cr hit

calls.name: Timken India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR929 crore (+15% YoY), PBT margin 16.2%, gross margin 39.9% up 100bp YoY; Bharuch ramp slow at ~INR50 crore quarterly revenue, near breakeven, with utilisation 40-45% on SRB lines.

calls.name: Seamec Ltd
calls.gLine: ANANT acquisition and deployment: Acquisition by end of Q1; deployment in Q3 (ONGC contract) (Q2-Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 41% to INR 297 cr consolidated with ~42% EBITDA margin, but growth rests on Seamec ANANT acquisition (USD 70m, 50-50 equity/debt) and redeployment, with no fleet-addition capacity discipline or utilisation figure disclosed.
calls.top: Fleet growth via USD 70m vessel buy

calls.name: Petronet LNG Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 and FY28 capex: INR 9,064 crore FY27; similar for FY28
calls.thesis: Petronet's Q1 FY27 profit rose 33% on trading and inventory gains (INR 301 cr and INR 193 cr) while Dahej utilisation fell to 66% on an expanded 22.5 MMTPA base, with Qatar force majeure still in place.
calls.top: Dahej utilisation 66% vs 92% a year ago

calls.name: R Systems International Ltd
calls.thesis: Revenue Rs 601.7 cr (+30.2% YoY, +4.7% QoQ) with adjusted EBITDA margin 20.1%, but organic growth is muted and management gives no numeric guidance; growth is largely acquisition and rupee aided.

calls.name: TD Power Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR2,600 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Order inflow INR7.34bn (+87% QoQ) and FY27 guidance raised to INR2,600 crore, but capacity for FY28 is only ~INR22bn plus ~INR0.5bn debottlenecking, with the expansion timing for FY29-30 explicitly left undisclosed.

calls.name: Skipper Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 order inflow: INR7,000 crores plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Skipper Q1 FY27 revenue +4.5% to INR1,310 cr with exports weak and 75,000 t capacity slipping to H2; reiterates 15% FY27 growth and INR7,000 cr order inflow, which needs a sharp H2 ramp.

calls.name: Quess Corp Ltd
calls.gLine: Net headcount addition FY27: 30,000 plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Quess Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 4,182 cr (+15% YoY) with EBITDA margin 2.02%, but the Rs 176 cr Labour Code pass-through and Rs 261 cr tax refund flattered headline PAT; underlying General Staffing EBITDA ~1.5% margin, and capital-cycle signals are weak as this is a staffing business with no capacity to cut.
calls.top: Labour Code: Rs 176 cr one-time pass-through

calls.name: Sheela Foam Ltd
calls.gLine: Overseas EBITDA: combined EBITDA around INR120 crores; revenue above INR1,000 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin fell as raw-material volatility hit gross margin, but management leaned on foam volume and overseas gains; standalone volume only ~6% and no capacity discipline signal.

calls.name: Shalby Ltd
calls.gLine: Hospital FY27 EBITDA margin: up to 20% for full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA flat at ₹49 cr on 11.6% revenue growth as margin fell to 14.5% from 16%; hospital standalone margin down to 18.4% from 21.6%, with management guiding to 20% for the full year without numbers on capacity.

calls.name: Indostar Capital Finance Ltd
calls.thesis: Vehicle-finance NBFC with disbursements up 44% YoY to INR1,235 crore and PPOP flat at INR93 crore, but PAT of INR11 crore rests on the old book running off over 2-3 quarters rather than on current-book evidence.

calls.name: Varroc Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 20-25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~30% YoY to INR2,634 crore but EBITDA margin fell to 8.5% from 9.5% on war-related costs and low-margin tooling; management guides 20-25% FY27 growth as an "ambition", not guidance.

calls.name: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd
calls.gLine: Business disbursements FY27: INR6,000-6,500 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 microfinance recovery: AUM up 11% QoQ to INR4,887 crores, annualised credit cost 2.1% vs 3.2%, NIM 12.5% vs 9.9%, PAT INR12 crores vs INR5 crores; no capacity or supply signal in the call.

calls.name: Computer Age Management Services Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
calls.gLine: Employee cost growth YoY: around 5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: CAMS Q1 FY27: EBITDA up 18% to INR183 cr with margin 46.4%, but non-MF margin fell to 13% on KRA price cut; management guides ~13% revenue and ~16% EBITDA growth for FY27 with cost growth held under 10%.

calls.name: Windlas Biotech Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR248 crores (+18% YoY) with CDMO +29% to INR207 crores, but Trade Generics fell to INR30 crores after codeine exit and management gave no numeric guidance; Plant 6 due end-H1 with ~INR1,100 crores revenue capacity claimed.
calls.top: Trade Generics INR30 crores after codeine exit

calls.name: Tarsons Products Ltd
calls.gLine: Panchla/Amta contribution to standalone revenue FY28: 20-25% of standalone revenue (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +21% YoY to Rs 86 cr standalone with gross margin down to 67.1% on 25-50% input cost spikes; capacity still commissioning with debt at Rs 380 cr gross and no major capex planned.

calls.name: Shriram Properties Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 PBT margin: 8-9% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 presales of INR484 cr (+10% YoY) and Rs1,560 cr handover pipeline, but Q1 revenue only INR271 cr (+4%) with PAT INR11 cr; FY27 is back-ended and margin recovery rests on handovers.

calls.name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Fresh order inflows FY27 over and above negotiated: around INR2,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR116 cr (+17% YoY) and EBITDA margin 27% against 35-40% guidance; order book INR920 cr with INR1,726 cr negotiated but unconverted, so supply-side visibility rests on unsigned orders.
calls.top: Order book INR920 cr vs negotiated INR1,726 cr unconverted

calls.name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year SSG: high single-digit SSG for balance 9 months (analyst framing, management said 'fair understanding')
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 SSG +3.8% with EBITDA margin 44.6% and store closures accelerated, but management sees competitor store exits in 8 states and guides to a stronger H2 with net positive year; no numeric guidance given.

calls.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
calls.gLine: OSAT + PCB FY27 revenue: INR450-500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR946 crore (+40% YoY) and EBITDA margin 15.6%, but operating cash flow was negative INR259 crore on inventory build of ~INR177 crore and metering receivables rising to INR1,311 crore; margin pressure flagged as a multi-quarter issue.

calls.name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 small finance bank with 22% advances growth, NIM up to 4.21% and PAT up 29%, but no supply-side levers; growth is loan-led and profitability gains rely on deposit repricing that management says is largely done.

calls.name: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost to income reduction: 30-40 bps a year (annual)
calls.thesis: Aadhar's Q1 FY27 is a steady housing-finance print: AUM up 18% to ₹31,364 cr, spreads held at 5.8%, but a cheque-realisation accounting shift cut disbursement growth to about 19% on a like-for-like basis and Q1 credit cost rose seasonally.

calls.name: Manba Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth FY27: 35% to 40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Two-wheeler NBFC grows AUM 22% YoY to INR1,731 cr with disbursements +37%, but QoQ AUM rose only ~1%, GNPA 3.41%, and management guides 35-40% AUM growth plus a planned INR100 cr preference-share raise.
calls.top: CAR fell from ~29.8% to 24.4%; INR100 cr pref raise

calls.name: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd
calls.gLine: Bio-chem quarterly revenue: INR190 crore next quarter (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Bio-chemicals revenue up 19.4% to INR168.7 cr with EBITDA up 53%, but consolidated EBITDA fell to INR2.6 cr (0.5% margin) as sugar/ethanol loss widened to INR14.6 cr.

calls.name: Network People Services Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: International revenue share: around 50% in about 2 years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue about INR 61.4 crore, down quarter-on-quarter from about INR 68 crore, yet management reiterated 60-70% annual growth and about 30% EBITDA margin with no numbers on supply or capex.
calls.top: Q1 revenue down QoQ to INR 61.42 crore

calls.name: All Time Plastics Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation FY27: approximately 75% on 41,000 metric tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up 25% QoQ to 6,323 t with utilisation 65% vs 52%, but gross margin fell to 39.5% from 41.9% on polymer cost spike; FY27 utilisation target 75% on 41,000 t.

calls.name: Vikram Solar Ltd
calls.gLine: DCR volume growth: 2 to 2.5x every quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume record 1,006 MW but EBITDA margin fell to 8.06% (INR1.25/W) as non-DCR pricing failed to pass through costs; management withdrew FY27 guidance pending H1 results.

calls.name: Infinity Infoway Ltd
calls.gLine: ZeroTouch share of revenue: 20% to 22% within about two years
calls.thesis: Small-cap AI/ERP SaaS story with Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 689 lakh, EBITDA Rs 344 lakh; no capacity or pricing data, ZeroTouch has only pilot orders and 150 machines built, and the Rs 75 crore order book is unverified.

calls.name: Tenneco Clean Air India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR350-450 crore (indicative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 VAR up 18.4% to INR13,816m but EBITDA margin fell to 17.9% on non-indexed commodity inflation; capacity tight (ART above 90%, CAPT above 80%) with capex INR350-450 crore indicative.

calls.name: Skyways Air Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue nearly doubled to INR1,216.53 crore on yield and volume, but management attributes much of the jump to fuel-linked pass-through; volume growth 23% is the cited driver with no capacity or capex signal.

calls.name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: approximately INR950 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹137.1 cr (+103.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin 28.3%, but no capacity cut or discipline signal; 18,000 MVA brownfield added for FY29 with ~1,725 MVA executed in Q1 on 19,200 MVA base.

calls.name: Glass Wall Systems (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Facade maker's first call: Q1 revenue Rs.107 cr (+36% YoY) and EBITDA margin 21.3%, with FY27 guidance of ~25% growth, 23-25% EBITDA margin and Rs.982 cr order book, but no capacity discipline data and a loose order-inflow answer.
calls.top: Order book Rs.982 cr, ~2x last year

calls.name: Supreme Petrochem Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit rose on wide styrene-to-polymer deltas while volumes fell 24.5% to 70,842 t; management gave no volume guidance and is adding ~80,000 t of PS capacity by Dec 2028 (~INR 450 cr, internal accruals).

calls.name: Voltas Ltd
calls.thesis: Voltas Q1 FY27 RAC volumes +45% and share 17.3% but UCP EBIT only 5.3% as commodity and FX costs passed through with lag; supply-side is a 1.5-2.8m compressor JV with 18-month runway, capex not yet sized.

calls.name: Novartis India Ltd

calls.top: E-commerce revenue Rs 89.49 cr vs Rs 70.03 cr

calls.name: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR 20,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 9.62% YoY to INR 4,300 crore and EBITDA margin 3.99% vs 2.08%, but order inflow of INR 5,417 crore is thin against a INR 93,492 crore book and management guides ~15% revenue growth with no capacity or capex signal.

calls.name: Antony Waste Handling Cell Ltd
calls.gLine: Labour cost % revenue: normalise to 30-31% in next 3 quarters
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell 27% YoY to ₹45 crore (16.8% margin vs 24.4%) on labour, transport and one-off disposal costs; WtE plant down until October, with ₹22-24 crore impairment flagged.

calls.name: G R Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: ~INR300 cr FY27; INR200-250 cr FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 32.7% to INR2,423 cr but standalone EBITDA margin fell to 11.02% from 12.65%; FY27 growth guide held at 15-20% and margin at 10-11%, with order book ~INR25,300 cr.

calls.name: Campus Activewear Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27: high single digits (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth of 12.2% rests on pricing and channel-accounting shifts; management is building festive inventory at record production, with volume tapering and no capacity addition signalled beyond ramp-ups.

calls.name: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Employee cost growth FY27: 22% to 24% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Prudent's Q1 FY27 is a distributor-platform growth story, not a capital-cycle one: equity AUM up 18% to INR1.34 lakh crore, but gross yield slipped to ~88 bps and commission payout fell after a regulatory reset.

calls.name: Ddev Plastiks Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: BESS EBITDA margin (supply phase): 6% to 8% (initial phase)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA crossed INR100 crores at 10% margin on war-driven export price premium; utilisation fell to about 66% as 48,000 t Bhiwadi XLPE capacity ramps slowly, with FY27 volume growth guided at 15%.

calls.name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
calls.gLine: Order execution cycle: 16 to 20 weeks
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR8,197m (+172% YoY) and PAT margin 10.3%, but inventory days jumped 86→110 and management declined to guide new capex, with a possible enabling resolution for working-capital equity or debt.

calls.name: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Land capex: Rs 15-18 billion for the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales about Rs 20bn (20% of Rs 100bn FY target), collections only Rs 6.7bn, and new launches guided at Rs 150bn; supply pipeline expanding while cash conversion lags.

calls.name: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt by end Q2 FY27: close to INR 1,450 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +22.8% to INR 2,580 cr with international +34.2% carrying growth; India only +10.2% and management guides India acceleration without capacity or supply-side signals.

calls.name: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Blended EBITDA margin: early-to-mid 30s, back from 26-27% pro forma (next couple of years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR893 cr (+12% cc) and 33% reported EBITDA (35% ex-acquisition costs), but TruBridge revenue reset to ~$300m from $340m with EBITDA held at ~$68m; no numeric TruBridge growth guidance.

calls.name: Ventive Hospitality Ltd
calls.gLine: Maldives margin recovery: Q3/Q4 to offset Q1-Q2 fuel hit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hospitality revenue up 9% to INR420 crores with India EBITDA up 16%; reported consolidated EBITDA fell about INR16 crores on Maldives diesel spike, with 1.2x net debt/EBITDA and no new capacity commitments beyond the pipeline.

calls.name: Kalpataru Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 pre-sales: Rs 6,500 crore (~23% growth over FY26) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with pre-sales up 6% to Rs 1,329 cr, but realisations fell on mix, net debt flat at Rs 8,229 cr (2.0x) and profits deferred to H2 FY27 under completion accounting.

calls.name: Vikran Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue from operations: INR2,300–2,500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 standalone revenue INR204 cr (+28%) with consolidated revenue only INR141.6 cr after NOPL consolidation; H2-weighted FY27 guide of INR2,300–2,500 cr and receivables (debtor days ~296) remain the key unproven items.

calls.name: Anlon Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT margin FY27 and FY28: 12-13% (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to about 17% on raw-material spikes and Remember India consolidation, with management guiding 25-27% for FY27 and FY27 revenue of 350-400 crore, unverified against an 87.6 crore first quarter.

calls.name: Glottis Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: Exceed FY25 revenue (FY27)
calls.thesis: Glottis is a freight forwarder whose revenue rose 39.5% YoY to Rs 2,345m while TEUs fell to 21,841 from 26,278, so growth is price/mix-led, with EBITDA margin 6.9% and no capacity-discipline evidence beyond its own fleet build.

calls.name: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd
calls.gLine: Underlying margin after one-offs: around 12%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales Rs9,708m (+18.3% YoY on assumed comparison, +2.6% QoQ) but PBT margin ~9% on FX loss (~Rs147m) and ~Rs150m demerger IT costs; management guides 12% underlying and capacity-constrained until new Pune plant in 2028.
calls.top: Capex INR900-950cr for new Pune plant

calls.name: Pine Labs Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue growth about 20% y/y with contribution margin dipping on upfront investments and low-margin device sales; management guides FY27 CM back to 73-74% and EBITDA margin not below FY26 23.5%.

calls.name: Excelsoft Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR350-360 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR802.63m with EBITDA margin down to 16.24% from 18.02%; management guides 24-25% FY27 EBITDA margin, a cut from the earlier ~30% view, and FY27 revenue of INR350-360 crore.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 construction cost: Rs 1,200-1,300 cr
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with net debt near zero post ITC sale; Q1 collections Rs 713 cr (+31% YoY) but net sales only ~Rs 329 cr with no launches and cancellations; BD still lagging against Rs 10,000-15,000 cr FY27 target.
calls.top: Net debt near zero post ITC sale

calls.name: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: NPK tie-up volume: 8.5 lakh tons tied up with vendors
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 12% to INR 851 crores on margin of ~17% despite revenue down 12%, but urea volumes fell on Gadepan shutdowns and a new 4th urea plant (~INR 10,000 crore) hinges on a government bid process due around October.

calls.name: EPL Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: high teens for next few quarters (next few quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 reported revenue +25.3% (20% underlying ex pass-through) with EBITDA margin 18.8%; growth guidance raised to high teens but margin held at 20% underlying, while Europe margins contracted and working capital rose on inventory.
calls.top: Capex stepped up ahead of growth

calls.name: Whirlpool of India Ltd
calls.thesis: Record Q1 revenue of INR 2,582 crore (+26%) with standalone EBITDA margin squeezed to 4.6% by war-led oil and forex costs and e-waste accruals; management gave no numeric guidance.

calls.name: ACC Ltd
calls.thesis: Ambuja cut low-margin non-trade volume (trade -2%, non-trade -21% YoY, total -7%) to chase value; net cost fell to INR4,241/t and FY27 cost target INR4,250 held, but utilisation is ~65%.

calls.name: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Sustainable growth in general medicines and vaccines: 8% to 10% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 15% to INR924 cr (about 9-10% underlying ex-CMO base), PAT up 24% (17% ex one-off), volume +3-3.5%, price ~6%; opex spike to be front-loaded and moderate.
calls.top: Innovation sales 7% of revenue vs 4% last year

calls.name: Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd
calls.gLine: Retail revenue (ZECODE+DEVO): INR160 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 total income up 16.4% to INR466 crore and PAT up 144% to INR11 crore, but retail build-out (ZECODE/DEVO) drags FY27 EBITDA ~150 bps, with no capacity or utilisation data disclosed.
calls.top: Inventory build ahead of festive season

calls.name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd
calls.gLine: IPP annual PLF / generation: better than FY26 (415 crore units)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹478 cr (+9.4% YoY) flattered by ₹110 cr one-off regulatory benefit; no FY27 guidance given, with management pointing to better July power prices (₹5/unit IEX vs ₹4.20) and hydro recovery.

calls.name: Bhagyanagar India Ltd
calls.gLine: Average realisation FY27: above Rs 1,300/kg, ~30% higher YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 5.43% and PAT margin 2.87% on 5,278 t volume (down 9.5% QoQ) as April–May supply shortage lifted realisations; management guides 5–5.5% margin and 12–15% volume growth.
calls.top: Capacity 35,000 t online; 45,000 t next year

calls.name: JM Financial Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ex-provisions after minority was flat at INR302 crores; Private Markets revenue doubled to INR462 crores on lumpy ARC resolutions while Capital Markets revenue fell to INR115 crores from INR182 crores.

calls.name: Hikal Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 14% to 16% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 403 cr, EBITDA margin 9.2%, Pharma EBIT margin 3.2% at ~55-60% utilisation; crop volumes recovering but China pricing pressure persists and FY27 guide of 14-16% growth and 25-30% EBITDA growth is back-half weighted.
calls.top: Crop pricing under pressure from China

calls.name: Blue Dart Express Ltd
calls.thesis: Blue Dart's Q1 FY27 growth was mostly yield-led: tonnage up ~7% and shipments ~2%, with management citing GPI and loss-lane price corrections, while air volume grew only ~2.6% and no capacity guidance was given.

calls.name: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue: Up to INR 2,000 crore this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin spike from cheap pre-bought paddy/rice inventory and a ~30% price rise; management guides EBITDA 8-12% oscillation and says revenue could reach INR 2,000 cr, with no capex discussed and volumes flat for three years.

calls.name: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd
calls.gLine: Brand-building spend FY27: INR 85 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +19.5% on volume, but EBITDA margin fell to 10.1% (vs 13.1%); management attributes ~4.35pts to one-offs and reiterates 13.5–14% FY27 margin and 18–20% growth, with sanitaryware utilisation at just 61%.

calls.name: Indoco Remedies Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone EBITDA margin: double-digit for the year (aiming)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin rebounded to 10.3% from 3.8% on 26% fewer batches and headcount cuts, but COGS up ~2pp from war-driven input inflation, US sterile plant still unaudited, and Europe/emerging primaries slipped.

calls.name: eClerx Services Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.gLine: CLX revenue growth: 0% to 2% full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 revenue USD 125.9m, +2.8% QoQ, EBITDA margin 23% on wage hikes; FY EBITDA guided 24-28% with midpoint the realistic pick, BFSI still shrinking and utilisation 75.5%.
calls.top: BFSI flat QoQ, still shrinking YoY

calls.name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: US generics growth FY27: mid to high teens (INR) (FY27)

calls.top: US generics guidance raised to mid-to-high teens

calls.name: Speciality Restaurants Ltd

calls.name: Snowman Logistics Ltd

calls.thesis: Snowman's warehousing pricing rose 5-7% and FY27 top-line guided 10-15%, but Q1 rail EBITDA fell on lower double-stacking and imports; management ties recovery to end of West Asia disruption.

calls.name: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Ltd
calls.gLine: Park additions: about one park every year; 12 parks by 2030 (FY30)

calls.name: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY30 revenue: INR1500 crores (FY30)
calls.thesis: Management guides FY27 sales above INR700 crores at 26-27% EBITDA margin, but the case rests on unfiled-to-approved registrations, a 208-day debtor cycle and hormone/biologics revenue not in guidance; supply-side evidence is thin.

calls.name: PSP Projects Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 revenue up 65% to INR853 cr with EBITDA margin 6.42%; order book INR13,245 cr (up 103%) but ~70% within-group Adani, and management guides FY27 revenue INR4,400-4,500 cr with 7-8% margin only in H2.
calls.top: FY27 revenue held at INR4,400-4,500 cr

calls.name: Tube Investments of India Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone capex FY27: Rs350 Cr for TI; Rs100 Cr Shanthi Gears; Rs600-700 Cr group
calls.thesis: Standalone margins squeezed by steel inflation in Q1 FY27, with management expecting full recovery via lagged price pass-through; engineering volumes up 17% and standalone PBT down to Rs213 Cr from Rs222 Cr.
calls.top: Steel price recovery lagged, full catch-up expected

calls.name: Zim Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth without EU-GMP: 10-15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 3.7% on ₹942m revenue (+31% YoY) with a loss after tax; growth hinges on an EU-GMP final report still pending, with management guiding FY28 +30-35% only if EU approval lands.

calls.name: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd
calls.gLine: Margin recovery: Recovery measures more visible from Q2
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹12,310 crore (+54% YoY) and BEV revenue +107%, but EBITDA margin fell to 23.1% on input inflation and pass-through lag; capex and capacity not discussed.

calls.name: Dodla Dairy Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin squeezed to 5.4% as milk procurement held at INR41.3/l against INR59.4 realisation; management guides 7-8% EBITDA margin and 10% volume/15% revenue growth, with only ~INR2 milk price correction taken so far.

calls.name: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd
calls.gLine: PVC-VCM spread: EBITDA neutral at $120-130; PBT positive another $20-30
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA loss of INR115 crores on high-cost VCM; management sees PVC-VCM spread near $160 from September but gave no numeric profitability guidance, with CMCD order book and R32 ramp as offsets.

calls.name: Supriya Lifescience Ltd
calls.gLine: EU audit Ambernath: second half of November (Nov 2026)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 190 cr (+31% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 25% on water and solar-power costs; management reiterates Rs 1,000 cr and 33-35% margin guidance, with Rs 35 cr sales deferred and Rs 230-240 cr inventory to liquidate.

calls.name: eMudhra Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: around 25%, PAT 16-16.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: eMudhra Q1 FY27 grew total income 28% to INR 1,925m with EBITDA margin 26.2%, but Trust token supply stalled on CCA ePass recertification, with ~INR 5-7 crore volume lost and Q2 top-line likely still soft.
calls.top: ePass token recertification pending with CCA

calls.name: Tracxn Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Top-line growth FY27: 15–20%, likely towards the higher end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Tracxn Q1 FY27 shows a demand-side re-acceleration story: revenue up 2.9% QoQ with international ARR up 4.4% QoQ, but margins still negative and no capacity or supply signals; the evidence is management narrative, not yet in reported numbers.

calls.name: KFin Technologies Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
calls.gLine: EBITDA growth FY27: 17% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 30% YoY (ex-Ascent ~10%) but EBITDA margin fell to 34.2% with Ascent (39.4% ex-Ascent); yield down ~2% QoQ on debt-to-liquid shift and a provisioned renegotiation.

calls.name: Ideaforge Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: Order book execution: INR256.8 cr delivered by Q3 FY27 (Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR68.6 cr (vs 12.8 cr) with EBITDA INR4.3 cr positive; order book INR256.8 cr to be executed by Q3, but no capacity additions and most FTP order inflows slipping to H2 or FY28.
calls.top: Order book INR256.8 cr to execute by Q3

calls.name: DOMS Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin (guided range): about 16% to 17% (FY28 onward)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +19.2% to INR670 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 12.3% from 17.6% on ~400bp gross margin hit; management prioritises volume over price and sees no further hikes this quarter.

calls.name: Carraro India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: up to 10% YoY if situation stabilises (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to INR5,447m but EBITDA margin 10.4% on unrecovered commodity and freight costs; management guides pass-through over 12 months with no quantified margin target beyond ~50bp uplift.
calls.top: Commodity cost gap not yet recovered

calls.name: Highway Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 turnover: INR 850 crore (INR 700 crore toll, rest EPC) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA just INR 4.8 crore and PAT INR 1.1 crore on toll traffic hit; management guides FY27 turnover INR 850 crore with no supply-side or capex disclosure, so the read is weak and unverified.
calls.top: Q1 EBITDA INR 4.8 crore, PAT INR 1.1 crore

calls.name: JSW Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: North EBITDA breakeven: Q2 FY27 at EBITDA level (Q2 FY27)

calls.top: GGBS growth cut to high single digits

calls.name: Dev Accelerator Ltd
calls.gLine: Signed pipeline conversion: 2.31m sq ft signed for future consumption; 8,500 seats at Ahmedabad DM project (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flex-workspace operator adding capacity: 1.13m sq ft operational, 91.93% occupancy, but Q1 consolidated revenue INR 53.8 cr with leverage flattered by excluding ~INR 226 cr lease liabilities, and supply is debt-funded expansion.

calls.name: Bata India Ltd
calls.thesis: Bata Q1 FY27 turnover Rs979 cr (+4%) with 130bp gross margin gain, but management flagged 5-6% raw-material cost push, a 2,000-store EBO base and A&P rising to 3-3.5% of sales; no numeric forward guidance given.

calls.name: Exide Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +17.6% and EBITDA margin 12.4% (+20bp YoY) on broad volume growth; lithium-ion ramp is the main capex story with utilisation guided at 25-30% and Rs1,400 cr FY27 capex approved.

calls.name: GHCL Ltd
calls.gLine: Vacuum salt and bromine revenue at optimal utilisation: INR150-170 crore revenue, 40-45% EBITDA margin
calls.thesis: Soda ash cycle still weak: management calls Q1 margin of 29.1% transient, guides to normalisation, and gives no greenfield timeline, with Chinese capacity cash-loss-making but no meaningful cut yet.

calls.name: Ion Exchange India Ltd
calls.gLine: Specialty chemicals capacity: At least 50% increase over next couple of years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell 49% YoY to INR 32 crore (4.54% margin) as Treatment Solutions stayed loss-making on legacy UP project; Roha capacity ramp is slower than the 25% first-year utilisation guided.

calls.name: LMW Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PBT up 151% YoY to ₹85 cr on flat sequential revenue, but machine tool and textile machinery volumes are soft, with textile utilisation around 60% and MTD capacity at 75–80%.

calls.name: Patanjali Foods Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 29% to INR11,337 cr with EBITDA margin 4.80%, but growth is largely price-led (foods pricing ~12% vs volume ~5%), no capacity signal, and staples EBITDA negative at INR-59 cr.

calls.name: Nava Ltd
calls.gLine: 100MW solar commissioning: by end of September 2026
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record consolidated income of INR1,269 crores led by Zambia power (MEL 89.3% PLF), but Phase 2 thermal slipped to Q2 FY28 and metals sales dipped on Orissa shutdown.
calls.top: Phase 2 commissioning slips to Q2 FY28

calls.name: Digispice Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Merger of DiGiSPICE into Spice Money / listing: completed by end of FY27 (March 2027) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Spice Money (DiGiSPICE) is an asset-light payments/banking-agent platform; AePS market share dipped to 17.93% in Q1 but recovered to 18.3% in July, with revenue flat and PAT Rs 6.6 crore. No supply-side capacity data; the read is mainly qualitative growth narrative.

calls.name: Centum Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: EMS margin: about 10-11% EBITDA
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue up 11% to INR205 cr with order book ~INR1,800 cr (+31%) and Q1 margin soft at 11.3% EBITDA; overseas exit done, but supply-side evidence is thin and the FY27 25%+ growth target is reiterated without numbers for the quarter.
calls.top: BTS order inflow +150% to INR120 cr

calls.name: Kilburn Engineering Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue ~INR117 crore with 20.1% EBITDA margin, but FY27 INR700 crore guidance held on an H2-weighted assumption with only ~INR485 crore closing order book and 3-4 projects slipping.
calls.top: FY27 INR700 cr held despite Q1 INR117 cr

calls.name: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd

calls.top: Work on hand Rs 4.5m civil vs 3.7m

calls.name: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd

calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 11% to ₹313.4 cr but operational EBITDA margin fell ~45bp to 12.85% on raw-material inflation; tractor volumes weak and FY27 outlook explicitly withheld.

calls.name: Zydus Wellness Ltd
calls.gLine: Effective tax rate FY27: about 25% including deferred; cash 12-15% of 25% this year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated sales INR 14,299m (+66.7% with Comfort Click consolidation); domestic grew only 4.6% as seasonal brands fell 12% and Nycil was hit by rain, with no supply-side or capacity signals discussed.

calls.name: Kewal Kiran Clothing Ltd
calls.gLine: Other income: around Rs. 30 crores annualised (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 279 cr (+19% YoY) and EBITDA Rs 52 cr (+29%, margin >19%) on 24% volume growth, but standalone slowing, no capacity signals, and cotton inflation flagged as a margin headwind.
calls.top: Cotton inflation may hit GP margins

calls.name: Orient Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation target: 70% to 75% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Ambuja Cements Q1 FY27 call (filed by Orient): volumes fell (trade -2%, non-trade -21% YoY), ~6.5 Mt of old capacity suspended, cost down INR206/t to INR4,241 but NSP weak and utilisation ~65%.

calls.name: AvenuesAI Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: INR 11,000 to 13,000 crores (~35%+ growth) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Payments-to-AI-fintech pivot: gross revenue up 109% but net revenue down 3% on take-rate compression, with EBITDA margin gains driven by expense cuts and FY27 EPS guided flat at INR 8.75–9.5 as incremental cash is reinvested into AI.
calls.top: Take rates compressed; net revenue down 3%

calls.name: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd

calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes fell 7% YoY to 40,729 MT with utilisation only 52-53%, but margin rose to 13% on mix; management says channel restocking resumed and capacity is ahead of demand.

calls.name: Epigral Ltd
calls.gLine: Long-term growth: 15% to 20% CAGR over 3-5 years (3-5 years)
